senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Provincial, national, belonging to a country, produced in it, &c.
E.
देश, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Fated, predestined.
m. (-कः)
A predestinarian, a fatalist.
E.
दिष्ट fate, affix ठञ्.

f. (-ता)
Fatalism, predestinarianism.
E.
तल् added to दैष्टिक; also with त्व, दैष्टिकत्वं.
